name: Loki, God of Mischief
effect:
1 “Nordic” Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
Must first be Synchro Summoned. You can only Special Summon “Loki, God of Mischief” once per turn.
This card is always treated as an “Aesir” monster.
Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can apply 1 of these effects until the end of this turn.
● All monsters your opponent controls lose 2 Levels.
● All monsters your opponent controls lose 1000 ATK.
● Each time your opponent adds a card(s) from their Deck to their hand, they must discard 1 card.
